record.body:
## Evidence

expected: R13 — the reviewer agent is generated per host from one canonical prompt and restriction set; the design makes `agents/reviewer.prompt.md` the sole authored source.
observed: the pre-existing `agents/se-reviewer.md` remains in the same `agents/` directory with a divergent description/body (still carrying the "Cursor equivalent" section and the "before the phase suite" wording), and `agents/reviewer.prompt.md` declares the same agent name `se-reviewer`. Native adapters pop `agents/` and generate from the new prompt, so installed hosts differ from a Claude/Cursor plugin install, which discovers both files as agents; `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md:422` dispatches the stale file, `GenericSkillsAdapter` fallback copies both files into a skills-kind host, and `orchestra/reviewer.py:427` still describes its stub as mirroring the old file.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Create a fix work-item under the retry budget, or answer Needs you.

payload.basis: Reviewer observed the pre-existing agents/se-reviewer.md remains in the same agents/ directory with divergent wording, while agents/reviewer.prompt.md declares the same agent name; the skill dispatches the stale file and GenericSkillsAdapter copies both
payload.claim: spec-gap on native-adapters: agents/se-reviewer.md and agents/reviewer.prompt.md define the same agent divergently, so R13's single canonical prompt is not actually the only source
payload.invalidated_when: fix lands and reviewer re-run passes, or human clears
